Subject: Private VPC trial and licensing questions

Irene,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the Private VPC option looks promising for our payments workload. Ben — thanks, great questions. I attached a draft MAP and SOW to this thread for your procurement and security teams to review (Draft_MAP_CloudInc_v1.xlsx, SOW_PrivateVPC_v0.9.pdf).

High level on your two asks:
- Commit vs ramp: we recommend a staircase commit: an initial proof-of-concept commit for the trial month, then staged increases tied to evaluation milestones (performance acceptance, production readiness, regulatory sign-off). Each milestone unlocks the next committed tier and the associated pricing band. If you do not hit a milestone within the agreed window, you remain at the prior tier with no retroactive billing.
- Platform fee: for Private VPC we offer two options — (A) fixed monthly platform fee (recommended for predictable budgets) or (B) usage-based platform fee as a small percentage of committed spend. For commercial negotiations we typically propose option A for enterprise customers doing on-prem because it simplifies internal chargebacks.

Proposed close-path and pricing triggers (summary):
1) Week 0-4: Trial/PoC — initial commit: 50 GPU-hours reserved, platform fee waived for trial.
2) Week 5-12: Pilot milestone — performance acceptance (latency & throughput SLOs). If accepted, commit steps up to 200 GPU-hours/month and 10% discount on token pricing.
3) Month 4-6: Ramp to production — full commit (customized), platform fee applies at agreed fixed monthly rate; additional 5% discount if sustained utilization > 80% of commit for 2 months.

I attached a pricing ladder (Pricing_Ladder.xlsx) that maps commit bands to token rates and the platform fee schedule. Rafael and Marissa — can you confirm the discount caps we can offer for a 12–24 month commit and whether we have flexibility on trial platform fee waivers?

Next steps:
- Ben: please confirm if procurement prefers option A or B for platform fee and share the procurement POC (procurement@cloudinc.com is fine).
- We can lock a MAP spreadsheet and SOW and route to DocuSign once commercial terms are agreed.

Irene
Irene Choi

Internal notes — copying short answers for the MAP and concession plan: 
- Discounting: for a 12-month committed ramp we can give a 10–15% volume discount depending on final commit band. For 24-month term, 15–22% (need finance approval >18%).
- Platform fee: default fixed monthly fee $12,000 for Private VPC (covers control plane, telemetry retention, and support). We can offer first 2 months waived if customer hits pilot milestone within 8 weeks.
- Trial commit: allow 30–60 days PoC with a low initial commit (50 GPU-hrs) and no platform fee.
- Contract language: avoid backdating discounts; tie discounts to utilization checks (we can implement monthly utilization reporting in Console).

Ask Marissa: can you draft a concise clause for the MAP that states "milestone acceptance" definition (latency p95 < X ms, throughput >= Y rps) — need measurable criteria. Also confirm whether finance will approve a 10% up-front payback credit for early signature.

Rafael
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per procurement's ask and our internal alignment, please find the agreed commercial MAP below and the next steps to get to signature. I pasted the key milestones here to keep all reviewers aligned; the attached SOW and MAP have the full language and acceptance criteria.

Agreed MAP summary and commercial triggers:
- PoC (Week 0–4): 50 GPU-hrs reserved, platform fee waived. Acceptance criteria: performance smoke tests and security scanning pass (see MAP sheet).
- Pilot (Week 5–12): upon pilot acceptance we increase to 200 GPU-hrs/month commit. Token pricing steps down per Pricing_Ladder.xlsx (Pilot band). 10% volume discount applied immediately upon acceptance.
- Ramp to Prod (Month 4–6): commit adjusted to final band (to be confirmed by utilization reports). Platform fee of $12,000/month applies beginning the month after pilot acceptance. Additional 5% discount applied if sustained utilization >= 80% of commit across two consecutive months.
- Term & Termination: Standard 12-month initial term with auto-renew; customer may elect 24-month term in exchange for higher volume discounts (see Pricing_Ladder).

Commercial concessions we approved: 2-month platform fee waiver tied to pilot acceptance within 8 weeks; 10% early-signing credit (applied as invoice credit within first billing cycle). Discounts capped per band in attached Pricing_Ladder.

Next steps (concrete):
1) Ben/procurement: confirm acceptance of MAP and preferred platform fee option (we've recommended fixed monthly fee).
2) We will update SOW and MAP with finalized commit numbers and send DocuSign link (targeting signature by 2027-04-20).
3) Rafael/Marissa: finalize measurable acceptance criteria and add utilization reporting cadence to SOW.
